content:
alex: FYI PR #38872 updates the LRU allocator + eviction heuristics. Planning to merge Fri 10:00 PT unless objections. Need quick eyes from runtime, infra, security. Link: https://git.redwood.co/pr/38872 :eyes:
maya: Can you paste the perf numbers? any regression or flaky tests?
alex: Local bench harness: median latency +1.2%, p95/p99 unchanged, throughput +3%. No flaky tests seen. Ran a 2h canary on staging with 5% traffic.
ryan: What's the rollback plan? also, does this change interact with the mem-pressure controller or node eviction?
alex: Rollback = revert commit + drain step; fallback to allocator_v1 variant. It doesn't change the mem-pressure controller, but it does change eviction ordering under pressure. Canary config I'm proposing:
```
canary:
  pct: 5
  duration: 2h
  metrics: ["p95_latency", "eviction_rate"]
```
Flag gated: `allocator_v2=true` behind runtime feature flag.
tara: Security quick question: are we introducing any new syscalls or mmap/mprotect changes? I saw a madvise tweak in the diff. :thinking:
alex: No new syscalls. We adjusted madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) calls and added bounds checks; I'll paste the diff snippet in a follow-up.
sam: If runtime + perf graphs look good I'm fine to signal LGTM. @maya @ryan @tara any blockers?
maya: Uploading perf plots now. Tails look stable to me, will give :+1: on the PR once the graphs are attached.
ryan: I'll review the canary infra (alerts + rollback hooks) and set thresholds. Will ping here when done.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for Fri 10:00 PT for PR #38872 per alex (automated).
alex: Thanks — will post graphs in ~15m and mark for merge window if no objections.
